summary.text: Son of Eusorus, king of an island in the Propontis who received the Argonauts generously and was killed by Jason in a night battle by mistake.

story.text: When the Argo was driven back to his island by night, Cyzicus took the returning crew for enemies and fell to Jason's spear; at dawn the heroes mourned and gave him burial.

Cyzicus ruled an island in the Propontis where the Doliones dwelt, but our city layer has no entry for Cyzicus or the Dolion shore — only the regional sea-name. Residence stays deferred until a polis is mapped.
